sentences.text: GLOW is an upcoming American comedy-drama television series created by Liz Flahive and Carly Mensch .	comedy-drama	comedy-drama

The series revolves around a fictionalization of the characters and gimmicks of the 1980s syndicated women 's professional wrestling circuit , the Gorgeous Ladies of Wrestling -LRB- or GLOW -RRB- .	syndicated	broadcast syndication	professional wrestling	professional wrestling	circuit	Professional wrestling promotion	Gorgeous Ladies of Wrestling	Gorgeous Ladies of Wrestling
The first season will consist of 10 episodes .
The first season will be released on Netflix on June 23 , 2017 .	Netflix	Netflix
